خَلِقٌ [part. n. of خَلِقَ]. ―
-b2- [Hence,] سحَابَةٌ خَلِقَةٌ A cloud in which is a sign, or trace, of rain; as also ↓ خَلِيقَةٌ : (S, K:) or a cloud giving hope of rain; as also ↓ خَلْقَآءُ ; (JK;) both are said by IAar to signify the same: (TA:) and ↓ خَلَقَةٌ [alone, as a subst., or probably سَحَابَةٌ خَلَقَةٌ,] a cloud that is equable, or uniform, giving hope of rain. (Aboo-Sa'eed, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
